objective: Reduce exact Boolean matrix-F4 row-reduction work on the public-synthetic n=31 Koblitz decomposition cell without changing the source equations, root set, lift gates, or solver budgets.

selected_policy.rref: block-4 M4RI when rows >= 128, columns >= 256, and columns <= 4*rows; active-suffix Gauss-Jordan otherwise
selected_policy.complete_leaf: verify the fully assigned point against the untouched equations without constructing another Macaulay matrix

environment_controls.KIC_F4_RREF_SUFFIX: set to 1 to force the active-suffix control

controls: frozen full-width RREF reference across dense, sparse, and rank-deficient matrices
byte-exact RREF and rank comparison across word boundaries
paired x/symmetrised solver run with independent enumeration gates
claim_boundary: Public-synthetic n=31 decomposition-kernel evidence only. The result is not a relation-yield improvement, an end-to-end index-calculus crossover, an asymptotic improvement, a sub-rho result, an external-target capability, or a key-recovery claim.
